description: Full planning application for the demolition of existing structures and construction of a building comprising student accommodation (Sui Generis), commercial floorspace (Use Class E), together with associated landscaping, public realm, access works, cycle parking, refuse/recycling stores and associated works. [For Consultation Purpose Only: The development would be part 10 and part 17 storeys and would comprise 437 student accommodation units and 1223 sqm of commercial space]
